name: Request Repo
description: Accept GitHub repository URL from client, fetch repo content from GitHub API, validate and prepare for analysis
projectAlignment: Core MVP feature. Implements 'User-friendly onboarding: Accept GitHub URL, handle cloning and analysis automatically' from project goals. Replaces manual cloning with API-based fetching to reduce resource usage.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept valid public GitHub repo URLs (https://github.com/owner/repo format)
Fetch repo metadata from GitHub API (readme, license, description, structure)
Retrieve file tree and content from GitHub API without cloning
Validate URL format and handle invalid inputs with clear error messages
Handle GitHub API errors (404 not found, rate limits, connection timeouts) with user-facing messages
Return structured response with repo metadata, file tree, and analysis-ready data
No size limits initially; scale as needed

technicalDesign.architecture: Stateless request handler. Client submits URL → Backend validates → Calls GitHub API → Returns repo data. Uses GitHub REST API (no cloning required). Follows project pattern: isolated request, structured response.

directories: src/handlers/ — Request validation and GitHub API calls
src/types/ — TypeScript types for GitHub API responses
tests/ — Unit tests for validation, API call mocking

keyDecisions.no-cloning: GitHub REST API used instead of git clone. Reduces server resources, faster initial response, aligns with 'scalable processing' goal.
keyDecisions.public-only: MVP constraint from project.md. Authentication/token handling deferred to future phase.
keyDecisions.error-handling: Structured error responses with user-friendly messages. GitHub API errors translated to actionable feedback.
keyDecisions.stateless: No persistence layer. Each request independent. Aligns with MVP 'ephemeral sessions' goal.

implementationNotes: GitHub API rate limits: 60 req/hr unauthenticated, 5000 req/hr with token. For MVP (ephemeral), use public endpoint without auth. When building, mock GitHub API for tests. Error responses should include suggestion (e.g., 'URL format should be https://github.com/owner/repo'). Consider caching repo metadata briefly if same repo requested multiple times in session.

status.notes: Full implementation + tested end-to-end. GitHub REST API client (no clone). Async background fetch. URL validation. Error handling (404, 403, timeouts). Job status tracking (PENDING→CLONING→PARSING→READY). Tests: 23/23 pass in Docker. Issues found and fixed: (1) test mocks (AsyncMock for sync .json()), (2) event loop handling for async tasks, (3) vite proxy localhost bug (use compose service name). Verified against real repo (evgenyFinkin/repo-assistant): 77 files indexed, status updates working through frontend proxy.
